regime_context: China A-shares show a clear one-narrative regime: Banks (512800.SS) lead with the highest score, durability, and breadth, while Coal is the only other eligible theme. The absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false), so the detector's only validated edge is absent here — the entire read must be treated as experimental/display, and with 0.337 directional accuracy in the track record, conviction should default low.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Coal's eligibility persists — if 515220.SS holds above its 10-day average while Banks breadth (0.944) starts to compress, that would signal a confirmed handoff from the one-narrative Banks regime. The watch retires if Banks breadth stays above 0.9 for the next 10 sessions.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only theme that is simultaneously eligible, high-durability, high-breadth, and trend-tagged. The one-narrative structure (absorption 0.35, one_narrative=true) means flows are concentrating, so an overweight (not a fade) is the only structurally coherent lean on the leader. But this is a focus lens, not a forecast, and the trend gate has no validated edge on this market — so the lean is a conditional expression of the tape's allocation, not a return claim.
evidence: Banks rank #1 with score 0.958, eligible=true, durability_bar 0.87, breadth 0.944, hurst_tag 'trend'
Banks are crowded (crowding_z 1.98) — a SIZE-DOWN caution only, never a fade; leaning overweight with that flag acknowledged
Rotation shows Banks as leader with margin 0.071 over Coal; directional=false
backtest_verdict: absolute_trend_gate did_NOT_hold_here, so this is experimental/display
theses.dissent: Banks are crowded (z 1.98) and mean-reverting tapes have whipsawed this exact trend gate historically — reflexivity could unwind the leader without a change in narrative, and crowded one-narrative regimes in A-shares often end in sharp shake-outs.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS closes below its 20-day moving average before the check-by date

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only challenger with eligibility (score 0.887, eligible=true) and is NOT crowded (z 0.5). Its mean-revert tag and narrow breadth (0.2) make it a fragile, single-name-driven tape rather than a broad thematic move — but the rotation radar shows it as the only viable alternative to Banks if the one-narrative regime cracks. This is a conditional lean on the challenger slot, not a momentum endorsement.
evidence: Rotation challenger to Banks with margin 0.071
gate_helps=false — no validated trend edge, lean low
theses.dissent: Mean-revert tag plus breadth 0.2 means this is likely a few volatile names, not a durable theme — and in A-shares, a coal-led 'value' pocket can collapse on policy signals or demand data without warning.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS lags CSI 300 by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: SOE Blue Chips (中特估)
theses.thesis: SOE Blue Chips are ineligible (eligible=false, score 0.672) despite high durability (0.88) and crowding (z 1.7). They are structurally the same value/financials complex as Banks but without the eligibility flag, so there is no trend-gate support. With no scorable ETF proxy, this is an avoid on the basis that the detector does not currently support participation.
evidence: SOE Blue Chips rank #3, score 0.672, eligible=false, scorable=false
No ETF proxy to validate any lean
theses.dissent: High durability and trend-tag mean SOE Blue Chips could re-enter eligibility quickly if the one-narrative persists — avoiding may miss a continuation of the same value rotation that banks lead.

falsifier.text: SOE Blue Chips would need a scorable proxy and eligibility=true before any lean is revisited

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable
